$comment: Source of truth for `bun run contracts:gen:all`.
Contract IDs are public on-chain identifiers and this protocol is open
source, so they are committed here rather than passed through environment
variables. Regenerating bindings therefore needs no local setup: the
checked-in values are the deployment the bindings correspond to.
`contractId: null` means the contract is not deployed on this network yet.
Those entries are skipped with a warning instead of failing the run, so any
existing bindings for them are left untouched.
To regenerate against a new deployment, update the IDs here and run:
HEADS UP: the files currently committed under src/generated are not raw CLI
output — they carry hand-written adaptations (camelCase fields, extra
`*Args` / `*Val` helpers) that src/clients imports. Regenerating overwrites
those and breaks the build, so a regen has to be followed by reapplying the
adaptations or updating src/clients to the raw snake_case shape.
